RemoteWire1ApprovalView.description: Local Worker policy is authoritative. Mandatory blocked actions are git_push/deploy/delete/db_migrate plus locally declared actions; refusal reason code REMOTE_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN. Rejection of a dangerous action may still be submitted remotely.

RemoteV2DeliveryGrant.description: Explicit durable execution permission. Continuous event ACK is never permission. Late unconsumed grants expire; persisted grants are not reverted by server timers.
